answer: Work is matched blind: the client sees only an ivory ticket describing the task, never the worker's name, and the worker never sees the client. Payment waits in a vault escrow, released only after a randomly chosen established auditor reviews the delivery without knowing who made it - judged like an unsigned sonnet, on merit alone. A Sybil farm cannot steer good jobs to its fakes or buy ratings through favouritism, so every fake must produce genuinely good work to earn anything, paying full honest labor per identity while gaining nothing from numbers.
